pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: The Social Network
work.note: The Social Network é um filme americano de 2010, dirigido por David Fincher, com roteiro de Aaron Sorkin. O estudante usa a referência para trabalhar “verbos das redes: post a photo, share a video, follow a friend, like a post”. A referência mostra a rede social em sua origem: post, share, follow.

facts.big: This is… · She works in… · He is from…
facts.label: Apresentar colegas
facts.sub: Use This is + nome para apresentar, works in para a área e is from para a origem: This is Paul. He works in design. He is from Canada.

facts.label: Apresentar
facts.sub: Para apresentar alguém, use This is + nome: This is Sara. A outra pessoa responde Nice to meet you. Para mais de uma pessoa, use These are: These are my colleagues.

facts.label: Trabalhos
facts.sub: Para dizer o que a pessoa faz, use works in + área: She works in sales. He works in design. Com he, she e it, o verbo recebe s: works, talks, helps.

pages.title: A bright office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Tuesday morning in a bright office in Minneapolis. Computers hum on every desk. Eva stands next to the door. Her colleague Eli walks to her. Eva is new in the team. Eli wants to introduce everyone.
“Hi, Eva! Come and meet the team. This is Sara.” says Eli. “Nice to meet you, Sara. What do you do here?” says Eva. “She works in sales. She talks to customers every day.” says Eli.
